name: Acapulco Gold
summary: A Mexican sativa associated with the hills around Acapulco in Guerrero, prized for golden-toned flowers and famous in the US from the mid-1960s. Accounts differ: one book places its roots in neighboring Oaxaca, and some sources call it a Mexican x Nepalese cross rather than a pure landrace. One of the three parents of Skunk #1.

born.display: traditional; famed in the US by the mid-1960s
